title: Train connecting China and North Korea arrives in Pyongyang after 6-year hiatus
summary: A passenger that departed from Dandong in China arrived in North Korea's capital Pyongyang on Thursday evening, state media said, after a six-year hiatus following strict border closures enforced in 2020 to prevent the spread of Covid.
